sources.title: Microsoft Local: Vaughan Construction Update (published 5 August 2026)
sources.summary: Microsoft's Vaughan construction update says the first phase of development of the Vaughan datacentre began on 8 May 2024 and construction of the building was completed on 2 July 2026, with equipment installation, testing and preparation continuing through early 2028 and the datacentre not yet operational. It then states that 'The second phase of construction is anticipated to begin in mid-2027' and that 'Microsoft will share additional information about the second building with neighbours in the fall of 2026.' It gives no address; the existing Atlas record locates the campus from York Region's YTO11 site-plan boundary.
sources.date_semantics: The page's structured data give datePublished 2026-08-05T04:49:29Z and dateModified 2026-08-05T06:01:36Z (same day), matching the Microsoft Local post-sitemap lastmod (local mslocal-post-sitemap-20261023.xml, which lists no later Vaughan post). The second-phase statement is an announcement made on 5 August 2026; the mid-2027 start is a forecast and no second-phase work is asserted.

sources.title: Cologix: MTL8 Montreal data centre page (version modified 22 September 2026)
sources.summary: Cologix's MTL8 page gives the facility address as 7350 Frederick-Banting Street, Montreal, and says that, located in Montreal's Technoparc, 'MTL8 delivers 206K SQFT of state-of-the-art data center space', that it is LEED Gold certified and 'consumes minimal energy, water and natural resources', and that it is powered by Hydro-Quebec renewable energy; it lists 'Site capacity: 21 MW' and offers build-to-suit hyperscale and enterprise capacity. The version adds that Cologix won the 2026 Datacloud Global Awards' Best Data Centre Sustainability Project of the Year for MTL8, 'a LEED Gold-certified data center located in Montreal'. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service.
sources.date_semantics: Structured data give datePublished 2022-02-09 and dateModified 2026-09-22T16:33:25Z, matching the data-centers sitemap lastmod (local cologix-dc-sitemap-20261023.xml). The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 30 June 2026 (ca-p1-cologix-mtl8-page-ia-20260630), which carries the preceding version (dateModified 2026-01-23) with the same facility statements but without the award sentence, and above by the live capture of 22 October 2026; the CDX listing (local ia-cdx-cologix-mtl8.json) has no successful copy between them (the 6 October 2026 attempts returned HTTP 504). published_at records the modification day of the captured version; it is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 22 September 2026, not an opening, inspection or commissioning date. 21 MW is a site capacity, not load in service.

sources.title: Cologix news release: La Caisse invests CAD 240 million to advance Cologix’s AI-ready MTL8 data centre in Montreal (5 March 2026)
sources.summary: Cologix and La Caisse announce a CAD 240 million senior financing for Cologix's Montreal MTL8 colocation data centre; the release states that construction of the structure and building envelope is complete and 'the AI-ready data centre is in service', that MTL8 is in Technoparc Montreal near Montreal-Trudeau airport, that it 'will deliver 21 MW of capacity', and that it achieved LEED Gold certification in 2025.
sources.date_semantics: Release dated Montreal, 5 March 2026 (structured data datePublished 2026-03-05). Outside the observation window; used only as identity and scope context (in service since at least March 2026, 21 MW as a forecast capacity).

sources.title: Cologix: VAN4 Vancouver data centre page (version modified 15 October 2026)
sources.summary: Cologix's VAN4 page gives the address 175 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, and describes VAN4, 'Cologix's fourth Vancouver data center', as an interconnection hub in downtown Vancouver's Gastown district, two blocks from VAN1; it states that 'VAN4 provides access to over 200 carriers' and cloud on-ramps, that all major Canadian telecommunications providers colocate at 175 West Cordova, and lists 58K SQFT across four floors, 'Site Capacity: 6.5 MW', 2 meet-me rooms plus 2 PoP rooms controlled by Cologix, 24/7 NOC and DCIM monitoring. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service. Its FAQ gives 68,000 square feet, which conflicts with the 58K figure; no floor area or capacity is recorded.
sources.date_semantics: Structured data give datePublished 2022-02-09 and dateModified 2026-10-15T21:29:33Z, matching the data-centers sitemap lastmod (local cologix-dc-sitemap-20261023.xml). The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 6 October 2026 (ca-p1-cologix-van4-page-ia-20261006), which carries the preceding version (dateModified 2026-06-22) with the same address and operating statements but a different specification block (68K SQFT and '4 MW of colocation capacity'), so the 15 October version is a genuine content edit of the VAN4 page; it is bounded above by the live capture of 22 October 2026. published_at records the modification day of the captured version; it is used as a publication-normalised operating observation on 15 October 2026, not an opening or inspection date.
